gates.requiredScope: Reader paths, operational claims, normalized source hashes, language partners and proof boundaries on the exact pushed head
gates.rationale: Feature-local test-only validation is required without changing repository workflows.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The source-matrix schema, guide structure or workflow-scope boundary changes.

gates.requiredScope: Local Markdown paths, fragments, reciprocal language partners and reader-path navigation
gates.rationale: The feature adds and changes Markdown navigation.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Markdown paths, anchors or provider workflow commands change.

gates.requiredScope: Learning package, generated secure-development documents and text-first learner accessibility
gates.rationale: The guide targets first-year learners and all supported operating systems.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Learner, language, generated-document or platform scope changes.

gates.requiredScope: Homogeneity, PowerShell analysis, whitespace, secrets, statistics and Spec Kit integrity
gates.rationale: Repository policy requires these gates for changed documentation and feature evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Changed-path inventory or repository gate policy changes.

gates.requiredScope: Existing Maintenance TUI build and tests prove documentation delivery did not disturb the operational project
gates.rationale: Existing provider regression gates remain required even though no runtime source may change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Maintenance runtime project or provider workflow scope changes.

gates.requiredScope: DocFX generation and browser Playwright/Axe validation
gates.rationale: The repository has no DocFX configuration or browser documentation test project; Markdown, learner-package, semantic WCAG and link gates cover the affected surfaces.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: DocFX, generated HTML or browser documentation tests enter the repository.

gates.requiredScope: SBOM, VEX, SLSA, OpenSSF Scorecard, AI-SBOM and dependency evidence
gates.rationale: No dependency, package, release artifact or AI runtime changes are permitted.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Dependency, package, build, release or AI-runtime scope changes.
